sources.title: New Twitch Drops, Thor (Ragnarok), Observance, and More

routes.title: Limbo Token exchanges
routes.description: Separate Limbo exchanges were announced for Magik A1 and A2. These material offers are separate from buying Magik for 20 Limbo Tokens.
conditions: Thronebreaker required by both recorded bundles.
missingEvidence: Current stock and remaining purchase limits are unverified.
Full upgrade resources must still be checked against the recorded recipe.

offers.label: 7-STAR MAGIK ASCENSION 1 BUNDLE
conditions: To access this offer: Achieve Story Milestone: Thronebreaker (tap Progression Badge at top of Home Screen for all Progression requirements)

offers.label: 7-STAR MAGIK ASCENSION 2 BUNDLE
conditions: To access this offer: Achieve Story Milestone: Thronebreaker (tap Progression Badge at top of Home Screen for all Progression requirements)

routes.title: Observance / Twitch Drops
routes.description: Spend Observance on successive Thor ascension bundles. The announced 50 Observance price buys Thor initially; it is not an established ascension-bundle price.
conditions: Observance drops were announced from April 2, 2026; the active drop campaign is unverified.
Buy Thor first, then A1 bundle, then the A2 material bundle.
A2 materials are per purchase; up to two purchases, with other upgrade materials still required.
missingEvidence: Ascension-bundle prices, current stock and current Twitch campaign are unverified.

offers.label: 7-STAR THOR (RAGNAROK) ASCENSION LEVEL 1 BUNDLE
conditions: Purchase 7-Star Thor (Ragnarok) to access this Offer.

offers.label: 7-STAR THOR (RAGNAROK) ASCENSION LEVEL 2 BUNDLE
conditions: Purchase the 7-Star Thor (Ragnarok) Ascension Level 1 Bundle to access this Offer.

routes.title: Action Figure saga exchanges
routes.description: Historical Action Figure exchanges included Chavez ascension. The older published class-token quantity differs from the November static pack; their price and contents are separate evidence versions.
conditions: Published summary: 100 Action Figures for A1 Chavez; 50 for one Chavez token and one Mystic token.
missingEvidence: No current offer verified.
The old 50 Action Figure price must not be applied to the newer five-Mystic-token pack.

routes.title: Mysterio's Helmets saga exchange
routes.description: Historical saga chase explicitly included seven-star Mysterio and ascension. Recorded rank-up gems remain separate rewards.
missingEvidence: Exchange prices, remaining purchase limits and current access are unverified.

routes.title: Locator Chip saga exchange
routes.description: Announced November–January Shuri chase. Recorded champion and rank-up packs contain ascension materials; progression and activity determine chip access.
conditions: Chips announced from EQ/Mysterium Store, Reclamation, battlepass, Sieges and other dated activities, with progression gates.
Not every chip source or reward is claimable at the same time.
missingEvidence: Chip prices and exact offer windows are unverified.
Current account progression, activity access and stock are unverified.

routes.title: Von Doom Armory
routes.description: DoomScrip supports ascension through Ascended Talisman/token offers. Ordinary Latverian Talismans obtain Doom separately; the 100-Talisman champion price is not an ascension price.
conditions: Own seven-star Doom and any two Victorious Four at A2.
Recorded first token offer requires four Victorious token purchases; later offer requires eight.
Event-earned DoomScrip announced to support A1; extra offer currency supports chasing A2.
Announced top-100 A3 / top-five A4 rewards do not extend the canonical A2 path.
missingEvidence: Exact Ascended Talisman prices/recipe, stock and personal access are unverified.

offers.label: DOCTOR DOOM ASCENSION 1 TOKEN
conditions: Purchase 4x Victorious 4 Ascension Tokens to unlock this bundle.

offers.label: DOCTOR DOOM ASCENSION 2 TOKEN
conditions: Purchase 8x Victorious 4 Ascension Tokens to unlock this bundle.

routes.title: Mister Fantastic (Victorious) Armory offer
routes.description: DoomScrip Armory offer: one champion token per purchase, up to two purchases. The purchase counter is not an ascension reward.
conditions: Reach Reclamation milestone 12.
The announcement supports A2 for all four through event-earned DoomScrip.
missingEvidence: The exact initial champion/A1 reward binding is missing; two offered tokens alone do not establish the full A0-to-A2 material budget.
Exact prices, activity access, live stock and remaining purchases are unverified.

offers.label: MISTER FANTASTIC (VICTORIOUS) ASCENSION TOKEN
conditions: Reach milestone 12 in the Reclamation War Realm Event to access this offer.

routes.title: Carina's Challenges
routes.description: Weekly challenges in Ordeal, Abyss and Epoch Gauntlet announced Maestro A1/A2 rewards separately from a champion selector.

window.label: Challenges announced from March 11; ascension end date unverified

conditions: Hero/Villain restrictions apply.
The May 13 First Appearance deadline is not established as an ascension-reward deadline.
missingEvidence: Exact objective IDs, thresholds, token payouts and present claimability are unverified.

routes.title: Abyss Quake challenge
routes.description: Defeat Abyss Quake using Star-Lord (Stellar-Forged) for a duplicate and ascension.
conditions: Seven-star applicability is matched to the recorded token path; the summary does not independently specify the exact star restriction.
missingEvidence: Exact objective ID, star restrictions, item payouts and end date are not captured.
A six-star source is not established.

routes.title: Necropolis Red Goblin objective
routes.description: Defeat Necropolis Red Goblin with only Blade (Stellar-Forged) for awakening and A1. This is separate from collecting his five pieces.
conditions: The article published June 1 describes the objective as already live then; June 1 is not an established start date.
missingEvidence: Exact objective ID, star restriction, item payouts, deadline and current activity status are not captured.

routes.title: Stellar-Forged Event Tower
routes.description: Beat Destroyer in the special Event Tower for awakening/ascension, followed by a Sasquatch test fight. Piece collection does not itself grant the Tower reward.

window.label: Historical Tower scheduled October 7; exact end unverified

missingEvidence: Exact token quantities, star restriction, objective binding and end timestamp are not established.

routes.title: Sizzling Summer Sale
routes.description: Historical progression-tuned offers and Units-spent tracker included seven-star Spider-Ham and ascension materials.
conditions: Progression-tuned offers; Units spent on Door Crashers and Sizzling Sale BYOBs earned tracker points.
missingEvidence: Exact token counts, offer tier, fixed price and probability are not established.
No replacement current method verified.

routes.title: Alliance Super Season / Realm Event
routes.description: Announced ascension mechanism for Magneto (House of X) through multiplayer objectives and a Realm Event during the November 4–December 9 event period.
missingEvidence: Exact token payouts, milestone/rank thresholds, personal requirements and live claimability are not established.

routes.title: Quantum Tangle sale / webstore chase
routes.description: November 20 announcement identifies five Medusa champion tokens, associated with announced A3. The canonical recorded path still ends at A2.

window.label: Scheduled November 20; end and timezone unverified

missingEvidence: Offer price, exact webstore tiers, purchase limits and sale end are not established.
No current offer verified; announced A3 does not establish an A3 recipe.
